title: Forward Like make_unique
prompt: Implement `makeOwned` that constructs `T` from perfectly forwarded arguments, and `restore` that forwards a single argument with the right collapse.

tests.name: rvalues stay rvalues
tests.hint: new T(std::forward<A>(a)...) — the temporary is moved once into T; a copy here (missing forward) counts 0 moves and fails.

tests.name: lvalues stay lvalues (copied, not moved)
tests.hint: The lvalue src must be copied exactly once into T — forward preserves the caller's category.

tests.name: restore collapses correctly
tests.hint: return std::forward<T>(x); — collapsing restores the original category for both calls.
